info.title: Fitadel catalog API
info.description: Foods with nutrition values, barcode lookup and search. Errors use RFC 9457 problem details (application/problem+json).

errors.description: Validation errors, one per invalid field

source.description: off = Open Food Facts, user = entered by a user

sourceRef.description: The id at the source, e.g. the Open Food Facts code

name.description: Display name: the first Accept-Language with a name, else Polish, English or any

names.description: All names by language code, e.g. { "pl": "Twaróg" }

basis.description: Nutrient values are per 100 g or per 100 ml

otherNutrients.description: Vitamins, minerals etc. per 100 g or 100 ml, for display

amount.description: In the basis unit (g or ml)

visibility.description: private = only its owner sees it

basedOnId.description: The food this one was copied from (a personal correction)

retired.description: No longer offered (gone from the source, or retired by its owner); still readable by id

items.description: Foods sold in Poland first, then by match quality and popularity

nextOffset.description: Pass as offset for the next page; null on the last page. There is no total count: counting every match would be as slow as the slowest search.

alternatives.description: Other foods with this barcode, best first

BarcodeLookupDto_Output.description: A barcode lookup result: the best match (food), plus alternatives
